conditions.label: Voice on Cooldown
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor's Shout voice is still recovering (just shouted).

conditions.label: Shout Equipped
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor has any Shout readied in the voice slot.

conditions.label: Unspent Dragon Souls
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is hoarding at least {param1} unspent dragon souls.

conditions.label: Absorbed Dragon Soul
conditions.description: Triggers for {param1}s right after the actor absorbs a dragon soul.

conditions.label: Shout Learned
conditions.description: Triggers for {param1}s right after the Dragonborn learns a new shout (reads a word wall).

conditions.label: Word of Power Unlocked
conditions.description: Triggers for {param1}s right after the Dragonborn unlocks a word of power (spends a dragon soul).
